title: Kingdom Hearts IV will launch in late 2027 and shows the world of Coco in a new trailer
summary: Square Enix presented an extended Kingdom Hearts IV trailer at D23, confirmed its release window for 2027, and showed the first world inspired by Pixar's Coco.

title: Kingdom Hearts will have an original anime series on Disney+ and Disney Channel
summary: Disney and Square Enix announced an animated adaptation of Kingdom Hearts, still without a specific date, with Tetsuya Nomura inviting fans to imagine the possibilities.

title: The creator of The Simpsons hints at the return of the Hit & Run video game
summary: Matt Groening hinted that the franchise's classic driving game will return in some form, although the current showrunner qualified it.

title: Stalker 2 will receive a major free 2.0 update with atmosphere and A-Life improvements
summary: Stalker 2's 2.0 update will add functional fog, improvements to the A-Life system, and a less hostile world, in addition to preparing an expansion.

title: A former Square Enix executive argues that removing discs on PlayStation would make games cheaper
summary: The debate over a PlayStation without a disc drive resurfaces after statements from a former Square Enix executive about possible price drops on the PS Store.

title: Video game media share their weekend gaming sessions
summary: Several publications round up in their weekly articles the games their writers are playing over the weekend.

title: Saber's CEO apologizes for replacing a writer with ChatGPT and then attacks a critic
summary: The controversy over the use of AI at Saber Interactive ended with public apologies, followed by an attack from the CEO on a Portal writer who mocked him.

title: The Witcher 3 designer explains how they got NPCs to react realistically
summary: The Witcher 3 developers recall the difficulties in convincing players that the NPC simulation was not a trick.

title: Marvel shows the Avengers: Doomsday trailer and reveals the X-Men cast
summary: New images from Avengers: Doomsday show Robert Downey Jr. as Doom, while the cast of the X-Men reboot is confirmed with Adam Driver as the villain.
